channel.title: Goblins Farm — Patch Notes
channel.description: A build-by-build record of what changes in Clash of Clans, read from Supercell's own game files: every troop, spell, building and piece of equipment whose numbers moved, and what is new.

item.title: What changed in the game files: build 18.600.3
item.description: What changed between Clash of Clans client builds 18.400.21 and 18.600.3, read from Supercell's game files: the Portal Pendant, Diggy at 15 levels, and a correction to the level 1 Town Hall on all 17 spells.
